label: Sticky cache eviction
summary: Core cache eviction falls back to replay because History, not worker memory, is authoritative.
details: sdk-core may keep workflow state warm in a sticky cache.
Eviction or sticky miss sends execution back through history replay.
Python receives a rebuilt activation after core catches up to the latest history.

steps.summary: sdk-core discovers that warm workflow state is unavailable.
details: Sticky cache state is an optimization for faster activations.
Eviction or worker movement requires rebuilding from history.

steps.summary: Core falls back to history replay because History is authoritative.
details: The replay path reconstructs workflow state without relying on sticky memory.
This keeps correctness independent of worker cache residency.

steps.summary: Python receives a rebuilt activation after core catches up to history.
details: The workflow continues with deterministic state restored.
Future tasks may become sticky again after the rebuilt activation.

hack_summary: Print control-path overlays for retry, replay, pause/resume, heartbeat cancellation, and sticky eviction.
